notes: V7.1.5: actually-working updater. Replaced the wait-for-exit loop (which was getting stuck on lingering APEX.exe bot subprocesses) with taskkill /F /T. Hidden the relauncher cmd shell with CREATE_NO_WINDOW so the empty command-prompt window seen in v1.1.4 is gone. Inno's own Launch APEX checkbox handles relaunch — no more double-spawn fighting the single-instance mutex. Every step now logs to %TEMP%\apex_update.log for easy diagnosis.
